defective_pattern: Allowing raw markdown syntax (>, ---, markdown links, unmatched asterisks) to leak into Word DOCX deliverables, using ambiguous question/hypothesis titles, or repeating headers like 'پایه تحصیلی (*پایه تحصیلی*)'.
why_defective: Causes visual pollution in official thesis documents and demonstrates lack of automated OpenXML typography hygiene.
observed_symptoms: Repeated parenthetical headings like پایه تحصیلی (*پایه تحصیلی*)
Headings lacking سوال اول / فرضیه اول prefixes
corrective_remedy: Enforce strict heading naming standard ('سوال اول: ...', 'فرضیه اول: ...'), strip parenthetical duplicates, remove raw markdown tokens from markdown source, and equip the OpenXML renderer with robust parsing.

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Detection of repeated parenthetical header strings, literal markdown tokens (>, ---, **) inside DOCX text elements, or absence of mandatory section prefixes.
